entries.text: Bitcoin is more than just a currency; it is a revolution in how we think about money.
Unlike traditional banks, Bitcoin is decentralized. It runs on a global network of computers called nodes.
Every transaction is recorded on a public ledger known as the blockchain—a chain of blocks that cannot be altered.
New bitcoins are created through mining, where powerful computers solve complex puzzles to secure the network.
A transparent, secure, and borderless system. That is the essence of Bitcoin.
